veranderings.voor: Die sprinkaan is dus in twee kettings
veranderings.na: Die sprinkaan is dus deel van twee kettings
veranderings.rede: A grasshopper is not 'in' a chain; 'deel van' is the natural Afrikaans for belonging to one.

veranderings.na: By die sprinkaan kruis die kettings
veranderings.rede: 'Daar' has no place noun to point back to; naming the grasshopper makes the reference clear without adding content.

veranderings.voor: breek ontbinders af wat van hom oorbly
veranderings.rede: Splitting the separable verb around a 'wat'-clause object reads awkwardly; a noun object keeps 'af' at the end naturally.
